compare_states.description: Rank the states on one indicator: which has the highest crime rate, the lowest literacy, the most forest cover. This is the question most of this data exists to answer, and it works across eight of the eleven domains. Every state comes back with its rank and value, plus the national average and the two ends of the range. Name a state to get its own standing alongside. Asking a domain that publishes national figures instead gets an error saying so and pointing at 'Get a trend'.

description: Read Indian government statistics from the Indian Data Project, an open portal that gathers official figures into eighty datasets across eleven domains: the Union Budget, the Economic Survey, RBI and monetary policy, state finances, the Census, education, employment, healthcare, environment, elections, and crime and safety. Rank the states on any indicator to find where literacy is lowest or crime highest, read a national trend year by year, pull the headline figures for a domain, look up what a term means in plain language, or fetch any dataset whole. Rupee totals come back in a readable form as well as raw, because they are quoted in crore. Nothing here needs an account, a key or a sign-up.
